description_expanded: OverviewHot TubGulf Place Condo Ground Floor! Steps to Heated Community Pools & Private Beach- 1 Minute Walk - The Sandy DogThe Space Gulf Place Getaway – Steps to Beach, Pools & Tennis! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 3 Private Beach Accesses – Including handicap-accessible entry 3 Community Pools – 2 heated seasonally for year-round enjoyment Hot Tub & Tennis Courts – Perfect for relaxation & recreation Ground-Floor Convenience – No stairs or elevators – easy access! Fully Equipped Kitchen – All the comforts of home for easy meal prep Wi-Fi Included – Stay connected while you unwind General Parking On-Site – Hassle-free parking for guests Located in the Heart of Gulf Place – Walk to shops, dining, entertainment & more Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free vacation Welcome to The Sandy Dog Across the street from sandy beaches & Emerald Coast. Fully equipped kitchen & all comforts of home. Patio faces palm trees, pond & fountain. Steps to grill, pool, & hot tub. 2 bedrooms/2 baths & hall bunks; fresh linens & bed coverlets. Washer/dryer. Sleeps 8. Park and walk directly into your ground floor getaway. No stairs or elevators to negotiate. Gulfplace includes 3 pools (2 are heated), 2 hot tubs, shuffleboard, tennis courts, bean-bag toss, walking trails, shops, nail salon, spa, outstanding restaurants, artisan booths and more. Nearby you can purchase fresh seafood to enjoy. And order your groceries delivered before your arrival, if you choose. Other activities: Enjoy a "Wine Walkabout" the third Thursday of the month. Sunday Church service on the beach. Artisan craft sessions. An outdoor amphitheater for kids play. High Tides, low tides, Evening Sunsets. Bike trails all along 30A. Oh, and Santa Rosa Golf and Beach Club is one block away. There are rental companies for bikes (including electric), kayaks, YOLO boards, beach chairs and umbrellas. With its splendid crystal-white beaches and outdoor activities, 30a is one of the top vacation destinations in the U.S. Within biking distance are Seaside, Watercolor, the famous "Red Bar", Seagrove, Rosemary Beach and Inlet Beach. Located between Destin and Panama City Beach, it an easy ride to golf courses, outlet malls, fishing piers, deep-sea fishing, shelling, dolphin excursions, and various other attractions. Just relax, take your time and enjoy! * 30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival** * No Pets! No Smoking! No Parties! The primary renter must be at least 25 years old with a ratio of one adult over 25 per 3 under 25 during spring break and summer seasons.** SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (8): Master Bedroom - King sized bed Guest Room - 2 Full sized beds Common Space - Twin over twin bunk bed AREA ATTRACTIONS: Gulf Place, just opposite Ed Walline beach access and located just steps from the famous sugar-white sand and turquoise waters of Northwest Florida’s celebrated Emerald Coast, Gulf Place is one of 30A’s original urban developments. The 25-acre community is located in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach on the corner of 30A and 393. Gulf Place was specifically designed to offer a one stop vacation destination with beautiful palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, outdoor patios with large umbrellas, a nature walking trail, plentiful green space, tennis, pools and more. Gulf Place offers amenities for all including a coffee shop, 2 ice cream/candy shops, Arcade for the kids, Yolo bike & board rentals, Shunk Gulley wine and spirits store, boutiques, gift shops, 30A store and more! There are casual to upscale dining options steps from our condo or a short walk to: Chef’s 30A Deli, The Perfect Pig, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill, Cava & Cakes, The Vue on 30A, South of Philly, Goatfeathers, Pizza by the sea, Basmati’s, Local Catch and Growler Garage. Also Awakening Wellness Spa and 2 excellent nail salons. Gulf Place host a fun wine walk each month spotlighting local merchants, delicious food and of course wine! Just a short bike ride away you can enjoy the Blue Mountain area and all its restaurant and retail offerings as well as the Dune Allen area and Topsail preserve state park. There’s lots of shopping in the Gulf Place area and a short walk east you can enjoy Lola’s and the Justin Gaffrey Art Gallery.Show less
